HEADER: NE Medium Undead (Archfiend, Boss, Earth, Shadow)
Aura Black Aura (10 ft., 2 shadow damage per round)
OFFENSE: Melee Bite +13 (1d8+9 plus Poison and Curse), 2 Claws +13 (1d10+12 plus Disease and Sap)
Ranged necrotic feedback +13 (2d6 shadow damage, range 120 ft.)
Burst Mode Oarsman of the Underworld
0th (DC 16) - dark orb, detect magic, disrupt undead, message, penumbra, touch of fatigue, touch of lethargy, touch of torment
1st (DC 17) - bone armor, dark, detect undead, dread, enfeeblement, fear, summon undead I, undead touch, virulence
2nd (DC 18) - bone shield, dark II, death armor, death knell, false life, ghoul touch, lesser animate dead, spectral hand, summon undead II, wound
3rd (DC 19) - animate dead, dark III, darkra, dispel, halt undead, mass enfeeblement, pain, ray of exhaustion, summon undead III, vampiric touch, void aura

4th (DC 20) - bestow curse, boneshatter, burning blood, dark IV, dread spikes, enervation, greater false life, greater fear, raise, shadow projection, shadow step, slay living, summon undead IV, undead torch, woundra

STATISTICS: Str 26, Dex 23, Con -, Int 19, Wis 20, Cha 22

SPECIAL ABILITIES: This Burst Mode allows Scarmiglione to guide his enemies to their deaths as he sees fit. Upon activating this ability, he may select any number of enemies within 60 feet and relocate them to any point within the affected area he chooses, so long as they are touching the ground; airborne creatures are brought to the ground, but do not take falling damage. A Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 HD + Charisma modifier) negates this effect. In addition, for a number of rounds equal to 1 + 1 round for every four HD, Scarmiglione's black aura ability doubles in range, deals 5 points of shadow damage, deals 2d6 shadow damage whenever struck in melee, and any and all attacks Scarmiglione makes deal an additional 1d6 points of shadow damage.
All creatures within a 10 ft. radius of Scarmiglione take 2 points of shadow damage per round. When struck in melee, all adjacent creatures, as well as the one who struck him, take 1d6 shadow damage.
Bite — injury; save Will DC 21; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect unable to perform Limit Breaks; cure 1 save.
Claw — injury; save Fort DC 21; frequency 1/round for 4 rounds; effect prevents from receiving healing; cure 1 save.
When either creating or summoning undead creatures through a spell, Scarmiglione only spends a standard action to do so, if the spell normally takes longer to cast.
When Scarmiglione is struck by a ranged attack, he may, as a free action, respond with a ranged touch attack upon the one who attacked him. If it hits, the target takes 2d6 shadow damage.
Bite — injury; save Fort DC 21; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d6 non-elemental damage; cure 1 save.
Claw — injury; save Fort DC 21; frequency 1/round for 4 rounds; effect 2d4 non-elemental damage; cure 1 save.

rulesDecisions: Actor data preserves the source statblock in biography and builder flags before any Foundry runtime hydration.
Only true feats, spells, and inventory placeholders are eligible for compendium lookup during import; creature-specific special abilities remain custom generated features.
Racial hit dice are generated from the creature type and source hit dice instead of creating class levels.
Source defensive text is mapped into FFD20 trait fields while unusual FF defenses remain preserved as custom text.
Natural attack items use source attack totals, source damage dice, and manual extra attacks for full-attack routines.
Spell and spell-like ability lines create spell placeholders that should hydrate from installed FFD20/PF spell compendiums.
Skill ranks are reverse-calculated from source totals after ability modifiers, racial modifiers, size modifiers, and class-skill bonuses.
